fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the new voice.

fields.name: audioSample
fields.description:
The sample audio recording file. Maximum size is 10 MiB.

Supported MIME types:
`audio/mpeg`, `audio/wav`, `audio/x-wav`, `audio/ogg`, `audio/aac`, `audio/flac`, `audio/webm`, `audio/mp4`.

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `audio.voice`.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The voice identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when the voice was created.
